title: 飛機電磁相容性驗證
summary: 以「把干擾源、耦合路徑與受擾設備逐一隔離」為主線，在低能量電磁相容示意與合成量測室中依序完成干擾源到線束耦合、頻率選定的屏蔽量、共用供電路徑的傳導擾動、底噪限制與假陰性、頻帶、模式與端口矩陣及專題交接。十單元各含機制、定量、驗證和診斷，全部算例明示為教學假設；比較情境由學員依模型建構，不是現場量測資料。
summaryEn: Follow Isolate interference source, coupling path and susceptible equipment in a Low-energy EMC schematics and synthetic measurements, progressing through Source-to-harness coupling, Frequency-specific shielding, Conducted disturbance on shared power, Noise-floor limits and false negatives, Frequency, mode and port matrix, then a course handoff. Ten units each cover mechanisms, calculation, verification and diagnosis. All numbers are explicit teaching assumptions; learners construct scenario comparisons from the models, not field measurements.
scope: 公開原理支持的原創航空教學。每個數值均明示為假設模型，非同名機型實際性能、維修手冊、製造工藝、取證判據或飛行操作。任務在模型完成，不提供武器、軍用性能最佳化或真機操作指示。
scopeEn: Original aviation teaching based on public principles. Every numerical example is an explicit hypothetical model, not named-aircraft performance, maintenance data, manufacturing process, certification criterion or flight operation. Tasks run in models, excluding weapons, military-performance optimization and aircraft operating instructions.

steps.title: 干擾源到線束耦合：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Source-to-harness coupling: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 干擾源到線束耦合 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Source-to-harness coupling and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 在「飛機電磁相容性驗證」中，本單元處理「干擾源到線束耦合」。導線迴路面積和電流變化率會影響感應電壓；縮小迴路與搭接是不同的控制手段。
steps.instructionEn: Within Aircraft electromagnetic compatibility, this unit examines Source-to-harness coupling. Loop geometry and current slew affect induced voltage; reducing loop area and improving bonding address different mechanisms.
steps.observation: 本單元為獨立假想台架，與其他單元尺寸及負載不可直接拼接。原創教學假設，非機型實測或操作值：互感 M=2×10⁻⁶ H、電流斜率 dI/dt=3×10⁵ A/s。關係式 |V|=M|dI/dt|；含輸出單位換算的算式 2e-6*3e5，結果 0.6 V。適用範圍：集中參數線性耦合模型；未模擬電弧或全機雷擊電流分布。
steps.observationEn: This unit uses an independent hypothetical bench; dimensions and loads must not be combined with other units without reconciliation. Original teaching assumptions, not aircraft measurements or operating settings: Mutual inductance M=2e-6 H and current slew dI/dt=3e5 A/s. Relation |V|=M|dI/dt|; evaluated expression including output-unit conversion 2e-6*3e5 gives 0.6 V. Applicability: Linear lumped coupling; arcing and full-aircraft lightning-current distribution are excluded.
steps.failure: 在「干擾源到線束耦合」的情境中，只改導線長度而忽略回流位置，可能使耦合面積反而變大。
steps.failureEn: In the context of Source-to-harness coupling, Changing wire length without considering the return path can enlarge the coupling loop.
steps.check: 針對「干擾源到線束耦合」，在示意圖上標出回流路徑，比較兩種線束路由的互感假設。 保留單位、條件及原始計算，並以另一種可能原因作對照。
steps.checkEn: For Source-to-harness coupling, Mark return paths and compare mutual-inductance assumptions for two harness routes. Retain units, conditions and raw calculations, and compare one alternative explanation.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 只把 M 改為0.5×10⁻⁶ H，其餘條件固定。用 0.5e-6*3e5 重算，結果從 0.6 變成 0.15 V。先預測方向，再記下對「干擾源到線束耦合」的意義與一項不能外推的結論。只在離線模型或紙上完成。
knowledge.textEn: Change only M to 0.5e-6 H, holding all other conditions fixed. Recalculate 0.5e-6*3e5: 0.6 becomes 0.15 V. Predict the direction, explain its meaning for Source-to-harness coupling, and state one conclusion that cannot be extrapolated. Work only in offline models or on paper.

steps.objective: 辨識 回流和接地搭接 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Return and grounding bonds and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 在「飛機電磁相容性驗證」中，本單元處理「回流和接地搭接」。接觸面氧化、緊固狀態和導電接片共同決定接點電阻；外觀相接不代表電位相同。
steps.instructionEn: Within Aircraft electromagnetic compatibility, this unit examines Return and grounding bonds. Oxidation, fastening condition and conductive straps determine joint resistance; physical contact does not guarantee equal potential.
steps.observation: 本單元為獨立假想台架，與其他單元尺寸及負載不可直接拼接。原創教學假設，非機型實測或操作值：測試電流 I=2 A、搭接電阻 R=0.004 Ω。關係式 V=IR；含輸出單位換算的算式 2*0.004，結果 0.008 V。適用範圍：低電流直流教學測試；不可把這個結果外推為雷擊脈衝耐受能力。
steps.observationEn: This unit uses an independent hypothetical bench; dimensions and loads must not be combined with other units without reconciliation. Original teaching assumptions, not aircraft measurements or operating settings: Test current I=2 A and bond resistance R=0.004 ohm. Relation V=IR; evaluated expression including output-unit conversion 2*0.004 gives 0.008 V. Applicability: Low-current DC teaching test; this does not establish lightning-impulse endurance.
steps.failure: 在「回流和接地搭接」的情境中，探針接觸不良可能被誤判成搭接劣化；先用已知參考電阻排除量測問題。
steps.failureEn: In the context of Return and grounding bonds, Poor probe contact can resemble joint degradation; first rule out measurement error with a known reference.
steps.check: 針對「回流和接地搭接」，比較四線式讀值與兩線式讀值，標出導線和接點對結果的貢獻。 保留單位、條件及原始計算，並以另一種可能原因作對照。
steps.checkEn: For Return and grounding bonds, Compare four-wire and two-wire readings and separate lead resistance from joint resistance. Retain units, conditions and raw calculations, and compare one alternative explanation.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 只把 R 改為0.010 Ω，其餘條件固定。用 2*0.010 重算，結果從 0.008 變成 0.02 V。先預測方向，再記下對「回流和接地搭接」的意義與一項不能外推的結論。只在離線模型或紙上完成。
knowledge.textEn: Change only R to 0.010 ohm, holding all other conditions fixed. Recalculate 2*0.010: 0.008 becomes 0.02 V. Predict the direction, explain its meaning for Return and grounding bonds, and state one conclusion that cannot be extrapolated. Work only in offline models or on paper.
